glance.headline: FCC approves SpaceX plan for data center satellites
glance.summary: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites for its Starmind initiative, marking the first approval for putting AI data centers in space.

glance.headline: 42 state AGs try to stop Character.AI selling chats
glance.summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data, including private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts, during bankruptcy.
glance.why: State officials are trying to prevent the auction of private chat histories from over 21 million accounts.

glance.headline: Nvidia hits pause on Southeast Asia chip shipments
glance.summary: Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

still_roasting.summary: Nothing showed its Ear Note AI earbuds arriving December 8th with a charging case that records, transcribes, and summarizes conversations.
Tidal will ban AI-generated music starting December 9th, deleting about 29 million songs and rejecting up to 85,000 tracks daily.

quick_sips.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years following research revealing troubling safety failures.
OpenAI is combining ChatGPT Chat and Work experiences into a single usage meter, which may limit heavy users sooner.
Amazon has held discussions about allowing Meta's Muse AI agent to shop on its online marketplace.

stories.label: New feature
stories.headline: Cloudflare lets websites add search for AI agents
stories.summary: Cloudflare announced a new feature that lets websites add search for AI agents with a single toggle, with site owners footing the query bill.

stories.headline: JetBrains coding model uses 45% fewer tokens
stories.summary: JetBrains launched a new variant of its open source Mellum coding model that uses 45% fewer tokens by not thinking, designed for quick code edits.
